notes: Initial N-14 8C (joint proxy statement/prospectus, filed January 21, 2022) for the reorganisation of Nuveen Enhanced Municipal Value Fund (NEV, target) into Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NZF, acquirer): NEV common holders receive newly issued NZF common shares of equal aggregate NAV struck at the close of trading on the business day before closing (cash in lieu of fractional shares), so nav_for_nav with no fixed ratio. Votes: NEV common holders (at NEV's annual meeting, which also elects four trustees) and NZF preferred holders (MFP and VRDP shares, privately placed); NZF common holders do not vote. meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are blank placeholders in this draft (meeting '[●], 2022, at [2:00 p.m.]', record date '[●], 2022', closing 'on or about [●], 2022'), so all are null. No outside/automatic termination date: the agreement can be terminated by mutual agreement, or by either fund for an uncured breach, an unmet condition, or a board determination that the deal is not in its fund's best interests (that board out is a termination right, not listed as a closing condition). The shareholder-approval and tax-opinion conditions cannot be waived. The 'other' condition is third-party consents, which the Q&A says include the liquidity provider for NZF's Series 3 VRDP Shares. The target must also declare a pre-closing distribution of income and gains. NYSE listing of the new shares is a reasonable-efforts covenant, not a stated closing condition.
